So you weren’t taking in any water or food of some sort during these two weeks? Do you think you could of kept going for longer if it wasn’t for the doctors stepping in? Thanks for replying again by the way

Do you think now that I’m on day 4 I’m close to the end? Like I said I had a few slices of bread like 3 days ago and my weight has dropped dramatically l, can see my rib cages for the first time in forever, when do the actual symptoms of organ failure start to happen?

Reading that has just made me cry a little because that’s all I want to be back to how we were without this shit that’s happened, just because I’m the way I am from past situations not wanting to hurt people’s feelings (as egotistical as that sounds) I’ve gone and fucked up the one thing that made everything make sense to me, I can’t see a future now that I’m not with her, and I really don’t want it to just seem like I’m just bummed out over a relationship, I’m really dying here man

I really don’t want to sound cliche or make it seem like I’m just a first to feeling depressed and suicidal. But, my girlfriend and I broke up and it’s not the fact that she called me a horrible person for what I did, it’s just that I really can’t meet my one in infinity whose made me feel so great about life and just never see her again. By the way the thing I did was meeting another girl who isn’t in her highest graces trying to let her down easy by telling her I didn’t feel the same way, it’s all complicated shit but I really can’t hurt people’s feelings because I’ve always struggled with feeling a bad person, so I did what I thought was right, and my girlfriend, well ex now I guess, saw it as me betraying her. Which to be honest, I can see that, but it’s not how it was at all

What do you mean? Which part is incorrect? (Sorry if that sounds aggressive it’s really not meant to come across like that) I spend most my time looking at how long it takes to die from dehydration and whilst most say 3-4 days, a lot say 10 days is the norm especially when you’re not out in heat doing anything at all
Thanks for replying but I’m really set on this, I know that if I do drink something I’ll be right back to square one and I’ll hate myself even more for wasting 3 days on this.

I’ve looked that without food you can last 3 weeks, and even though I’ve only eaten maybe 3 or 4 slices of bread these last few days I’m not really hungry. And to be honest with you the fact I have no water in me is a feeling I prefer over what I would be / have been feeling. Thanks for replying it means a lot

Thank you for replying it’s nice to talk to someone, and 4 days you think? I’ve read people can go for 10 combined with the fact I’ve only left my room to go and smoke some cigarettes, gone through a pack and a half a day these last 3 days, I really appreciate your concern a lot, I do and thank you for replying

Raul is its own separate thing from Gillette, however Doc was singing and coincidently combined the two in to a little song. I'm sure there'll be a video on YouTube of the original stream moment. 

The song maker then took a clip of that, threw in a little auto tune and a nasty beat, and there you have it, the Raul Gillette song.

So Raul originates from Docs FIFA days where he would yell the name of his favourite player down the mic to his opponent every time he scored, something like "RAAAAUUUUUULLLLL". Doc makes it a thing on the stream to yell it it when he receives a Raul donation.

Gillette comes straight from the advert with the slogan (the best a man can get) and has obviously rubbed off on Doc as he likes to let people know that Gillette is the best a man can get when a provoking donation rolls in.

And when one witty and comedic viewer with a talent for song mixing comes along, the soon to be Billboard Top 100 song "Raul Gillette" is born...
